citations.description: Ticket comments reviewed via show_ticket: (1) PLAN-REVIEW BLOCK, (2) SUPERSEDED by eb58, (3) PRE-EMPTIVE REMEDIATION, (4) CHECKED FOR SUPERSESSION, (5) PRE-IMPLEMENTATION CORRECTION. None contains a gate run attestation with usage log data.

findings.criterion: [operator-attested] a real gate run on the non-default provider shows the per-pass model ids actually used, cited from the run's usage log in a comment
findings.detail: The ticket's five comments contain only planning, correction, and supersession notes. None records a real gate run on a non-default provider (e.g. Bedrock) with per-pass model ids cited from a usage log. The operator-attested criterion requires a concrete attestation naming at least one verifiable specific (a run id, a log excerpt, a timestamp, or an observed model id per pass). No such attestation is present.
findings.remediation: Run the code-review gate against a real diff with a Bedrock provider configuration (e.g. REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL=bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8 and REBAR_LLM_STANDARD_MODEL=bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6), capture the usage log output showing per-pass model ids, and post a ticket comment citing the run id/timestamp and the observed model ids for each pass (base/round_a/round_b on opus, verify/coach on sonnet).

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
